basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Portland, Oregon. I work as a junior network administrator and spend my free time tinkering with Raspberry Pi projects and exploring new tech trends. I'm relatively new to Reddit, mostly browsing through car-related subreddits and finding humor in charred memes. I enjoy learning about cryptocurrency trading, although I haven't invested much myself. Usually, I'm online during evenings after work and aim to expand my knowledge of networking and IoT devices. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends on road trips or exploring nearby hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology and gained most of my practical experience through self-teaching and online courses. My current job as a junior network administrator allows me to work with networking hardware and software, which fuels my interest in Raspberry Pi projects.
